name: ai-plugins
description: Plugins for working on large codebases without burning context — discovery discipline, migration playbooks, and the hooks that enforce them.

plugins.name: code-change-discipline
plugins.description: Stop the agent from grepping its way through a large repo. A discovery ladder over a code knowledge graph with silent-truncation detection, LSP as the tiebreaker, narrow-window editing, verification by test count, and a sweeping-change playbook for migrations that outgrow one context. Requires codebase-memory-mcp.
